comment: FundsXML 4 data-quality checks (XQuery 3.1). Each check returns one text per finding; none = passed. The prolog is put in front of every check. severity: error | warning | info (a hint). xpath: an XPath 3.1 expression without the prolog that selects the nodes the check reports (Query Console, documentation). Developed and tested against the fundsxml/examples repository.

checks.name: DQ: Control data complete
checks.description: ControlData has UniqueDocumentID, DocumentGenerated, ContentDate and the data supplier's name.
checks.xpath: /FundsXML4[not(ControlData)] | /FundsXML4/ControlData[not(UniqueDocumentID and DocumentGenerated and ContentDate and DataSupplier/Name)]

checks.name: DQ: Content date not in the future
checks.description: The ContentDate is not later than today.
checks.xpath: /FundsXML4/ControlData/ContentDate[. castable as xs:date][xs:date(.) gt current-date()]

checks.name: DQ: ISIN check digits
checks.description: Every ISIN has 12 characters and a correct check digit (ISO 6166).
checks.xpath: //ISIN[let $s := normalize-space(.) return not(if (matches($s, '^[A-Z]{2}[A-Z0-9]{9}[0-9]$')) then (let $d := string-join(string-to-codepoints(substring($s, 1, 11)) ! (if (. ge 65) then string(. - 55) else codepoints-to-string(.))), $r := reverse(string-to-codepoints($d) ! (. - 48)), $sum := sum(for $i in 1 to count($r) return if ($i mod 2 = 1) then (let $x := $r[$i] * 2 return if ($x gt 9) then $x - 9 else $x) else $r[$i]) return (10 - $sum mod 10) mod 10 = xs:integer(substring($s, 12, 1))) else false())]
checks.query:
for $i in //ISIN[not(local:isin-ok(normalize-space(.)))]
return local:at($i, local:where($i) || ': ISIN ' || $i || ' is invalid')

checks.name: DQ: LEI check digits
checks.description: Every LEI has 20 characters and correct check digits (ISO 17442).
checks.xpath: //LEI[let $s := normalize-space(.) return not(if (matches($s, '^[A-Z0-9]{18}[0-9]{2}$')) then xs:integer(string-join(string-to-codepoints($s) ! (if (. ge 65) then string(. - 55) else codepoints-to-string(.)))) mod 97 = 1 else false())]
checks.query:
for $l in //LEI[not(local:lei-ok(normalize-space(.)))]
return local:at($l, local:where($l) || ': LEI ' || $l || ' is invalid')

checks.name: DQ: Currency codes
checks.description: Currencies and ccy attributes are three capital letters (ISO 4217).
checks.xpath: //*[local-name() = ('Currency', 'CurrencyBuy', 'CurrencySell', 'PriceCurrency', 'SettlementCurrency')][not(*)][not(matches(normalize-space(.), '^[A-Z]{3}$'))] | //@ccy[not(matches(., '^[A-Z]{3}$'))]

checks.name: DQ: Position weights add up to 100 %
checks.description: The TotalPercentage of all positions of a fund, share class, segment or subfund on a date (over all its own portfolios) add up to 100 % (± 0.5). Share-class portfolios are weighted against the share class, not the fund.
checks.xpath: //Portfolios[Portfolio/Positions/Position/TotalPercentage][some $d in distinct-values(Portfolio/NavDate) satisfies abs(sum(Portfolio[NavDate = $d]/Positions/Position/TotalPercentage[. castable as xs:decimal] ! xs:decimal(.)) - 100) gt 0.5]

checks.name: DQ: Positions vs. net asset value
checks.description: The market values of all positions of a fund, share class, segment or subfund on a date (in its currency, over all its own portfolios) match its own total net asset value of that date (± 1 %).
checks.xpath: //Portfolios[Portfolio/Positions/Position][let $ps := ., $ccy := string((ancestor::*[self::ShareClass or self::Segment or self::Subfund or self::Fund][1]/Currency, ancestor::Fund[1]/Currency)[1]) return some $d in distinct-values(Portfolio/NavDate) satisfies (let $tna := ($ps/../TotalAssetValues/TotalAssetValue[NavDate = $d]/TotalNetAssetValue/Amount[@ccy = $ccy][. castable as xs:decimal])[1] ! xs:decimal(.), $sum := sum($ps/Portfolio[NavDate = $d]/Positions/Position/TotalValue/Amount[@ccy = $ccy][. castable as xs:decimal] ! xs:decimal(.)) return exists($tna) and $tna ne 0 and abs($sum - $tna) div abs($tna) gt 0.01)]

checks.name: DQ: No duplicate positions
checks.description: A portfolio lists every position (UniqueID) once.
checks.xpath: //Portfolios/Portfolio/Positions/Position[UniqueID = preceding-sibling::Position/UniqueID]

checks.name: DQ: Positions have master data
checks.description: Every portfolio position's UniqueID has an Asset in AssetMasterData (when the document has AssetMasterData).
checks.xpath: //Portfolios/Portfolio/Positions/Position[exists(/FundsXML4/AssetMasterData/Asset)][not(UniqueID = /FundsXML4/AssetMasterData/Asset/UniqueID)]
checks.query:
let $assets := /FundsXML4/AssetMasterData/Asset/UniqueID
where exists($assets)
return for $pos in //Portfolios/Portfolio/Positions/Position[not(UniqueID = $assets)]
       return local:at($pos, 'Position ' || $pos/UniqueID || ' has no Asset in AssetMasterData')

checks.name: DQ: Unused master data
checks.description: Assets in AssetMasterData that no position, transaction or earning refers to.
checks.xpath: /FundsXML4/AssetMasterData/Asset[not(UniqueID = (//Portfolios/Portfolio/Positions/Position/UniqueID, //Transaction/AssetUniqueID, //Earning/AssetUniqueID))]

checks.name: DQ: No negative values of securities
checks.description: Equities, bonds, fund shares, certificates and warrants have no negative market value.
checks.xpath: //Portfolios/Portfolio/Positions/Position[Equity or Bond or ShareClass or Certificate or Warrant][xs:decimal((TotalValue/Amount)[1][. castable as xs:decimal]) lt 0]

checks.name: DQ: Securities have an identifier
checks.description: Equities, bonds, fund shares, certificates and warrants carry an identifier (ISIN …).
checks.xpath: //Portfolios/Portfolio/Positions/Position[Equity or Bond or ShareClass or Certificate or Warrant][not(Identifiers/*)]
checks.query:
for $pos in //Portfolios/Portfolio/Positions/Position[Equity or Bond or ShareClass or Certificate or Warrant][not(Identifiers/*)]
return local:at($pos, 'Position ' || $pos/UniqueID || ' has no identifier')

checks.name: DQ: Portfolio dates have a net asset value
checks.description: Every portfolio's NavDate has a TotalAssetValue of the node it belongs to (fund, share class, segment, subfund) for that date.
checks.xpath: //Portfolios/Portfolio[NavDate][exists(../../TotalAssetValues/TotalAssetValue)][not(NavDate = ../../TotalAssetValues/TotalAssetValue/NavDate)]
checks.query:
for $p in //Portfolios/Portfolio[NavDate]
let $tavs := $p/../../TotalAssetValues/TotalAssetValue
where exists($tavs) and not($p/NavDate = $tavs/NavDate)
return local:at($p, local:owner($p) || ': no net asset value for the portfolio date ' || $p/NavDate)

checks.name: DQ: Share classes add up to the fund
checks.description: The net asset values of the share classes (in fund currency) add up to the fund's (± 0.5 %) for each date.
checks.xpath: //Funds/Fund[SingleFund/ShareClasses/ShareClass/TotalAssetValues]/FundDynamicData/TotalAssetValues/TotalAssetValue[let $t := ., $f := ancestor::Fund[1], $ccy := string($f/Currency), $tna := ($t/TotalNetAssetValue/Amount[@ccy = $ccy][. castable as xs:decimal])[1] ! xs:decimal(.), $cl := $f/SingleFund/ShareClasses/ShareClass/TotalAssetValues/TotalAssetValue[NavDate = $t/NavDate]/TotalNetAssetValue/Amount[@ccy = $ccy][. castable as xs:decimal] return exists($tna) and exists($cl) and $tna ne 0 and abs(sum($cl ! xs:decimal(.)) - $tna) div abs($tna) gt 0.005]

checks.name: DQ: Price × shares = share class value
checks.description: NAV price × shares outstanding of a share class matches its net asset value (± 1 %).
checks.xpath: //ShareClass/TotalAssetValues/TotalAssetValue[let $t := ., $price := ($t/../../Prices/Price[NavDate = $t/NavDate])[1], $p := ($price/NavPrice[. castable as xs:decimal])[1] ! xs:decimal(.), $sh := ($t/SharesOutstanding[. castable as xs:decimal])[1] ! xs:decimal(.), $tna := (($t/TotalNetAssetValue/Amount[@ccy = $price/PriceCurrency], $t/TotalNetAssetValue/Amount)[. castable as xs:decimal])[1] ! xs:decimal(.) return exists($p) and exists($sh) and exists($tna) and $tna ne 0 and abs($p * $sh - $tna) div abs($tna) gt 0.01]

checks.name: DQ: Transactions settle after entry
checks.description: A transaction's ValutaDate is not before its EntryDate.
checks.xpath: //Transaction[ValutaDate castable as xs:date and EntryDate castable as xs:date][xs:date(ValutaDate) lt xs:date(EntryDate)]

checks.name: DQ: No matured instruments held
checks.description: Positions in bonds, futures, options, swaps, warrants … whose maturity date is before the content date.
checks.xpath: /FundsXML4/AssetMasterData/Asset[/FundsXML4/ControlData/ContentDate castable as xs:date][(AssetDetails/*/MaturityDate)[1] castable as xs:date][xs:date((AssetDetails/*/MaturityDate)[1]) lt xs:date(/FundsXML4/ControlData/ContentDate)][UniqueID = //Portfolios/Portfolio/Positions/Position/UniqueID]

checks.name: DQ: Positions valued in their owner's currency
checks.description: Every portfolio position has a TotalValue amount in the currency of its fund, share class, segment or subfund (the sums against the net asset value need it).
checks.xpath: //Portfolios/Portfolio/Positions/Position[let $ccy := string((ancestor::*[self::ShareClass or self::Segment or self::Subfund or self::Fund][1]/Currency, ancestor::Fund[1]/Currency)[1]) return $ccy ne '' and not(TotalValue/Amount/@ccy = $ccy)]

checks.name: DQ: Net asset value in the owner's currency
checks.description: Every TotalAssetValue has a TotalNetAssetValue amount in the currency of its fund, share class, segment or subfund.
checks.xpath: //TotalAssetValues/TotalAssetValue[TotalNetAssetValue/Amount][let $ccy := string((ancestor::*[self::ShareClass or self::Segment or self::Subfund or self::Fund][1]/Currency, ancestor::Fund[1]/Currency)[1]) return $ccy ne '' and not(TotalNetAssetValue/Amount/@ccy = $ccy)]

checks.name: DQ: No duplicate assets
checks.description: AssetMasterData lists every asset (UniqueID) once.
checks.xpath: /FundsXML4/AssetMasterData/Asset[UniqueID = preceding-sibling::Asset/UniqueID]

checks.name: DQ: One asset per ISIN
checks.description: No two assets in AssetMasterData carry the same ISIN.
checks.xpath: /FundsXML4/AssetMasterData/Asset[Identifiers/ISIN ! normalize-space(.) = preceding-sibling::Asset/Identifiers/ISIN ! normalize-space(.)]

checks.name: DQ: Position ISIN matches the master data
checks.description: A position's ISIN is the ISIN of the asset with the same UniqueID in AssetMasterData.
checks.xpath: //Portfolios/Portfolio/Positions/Position[Identifiers/ISIN][let $pos := ., $a := (/FundsXML4/AssetMasterData/Asset[UniqueID = $pos/UniqueID])[1] return exists($a/Identifiers/ISIN) and normalize-space($pos/Identifiers/ISIN[1]) ne normalize-space($a/Identifiers/ISIN[1])]

checks.name: DQ: Transactions and earnings have master data
checks.description: Every AssetUniqueID of a transaction or earning has an Asset in AssetMasterData (when the document has AssetMasterData).
checks.xpath: (//Transaction/AssetUniqueID | //Earning/AssetUniqueID)[exists(/FundsXML4/AssetMasterData/Asset)][not(. = /FundsXML4/AssetMasterData/Asset/UniqueID)]
checks.query:
let $ids := /FundsXML4/AssetMasterData/Asset/UniqueID
where exists($ids)
return for $ref in (//Transaction/AssetUniqueID, //Earning/AssetUniqueID)[not(. = $ids)]
       let $owner := if ($ref/parent::Transaction) then 'Transaction ' || $ref/../TransactionID else 'Earning ' || $ref/../EarningID
       return local:at($ref, $owner || ': asset ' || $ref || ' is not in AssetMasterData')

checks.name: DQ: No duplicate transactions
checks.description: A portfolio lists every transaction (TransactionID) once; cancellations (CancellationFlag) are not counted.
checks.xpath: //Transactions/Transaction[not(CancellationFlag = ('true', '1'))][TransactionID = preceding-sibling::Transaction[not(CancellationFlag = ('true', '1'))]/TransactionID]

checks.name: DQ: Securities in the master data have an ISIN
checks.description: Assets of type EQ (equity), BO (bond) and SC (fund share) carry an ISIN.
checks.xpath: /FundsXML4/AssetMasterData/Asset[AssetType = ('EQ', 'BO', 'SC')][not(Identifiers/ISIN)]
checks.query:
for $a in /FundsXML4/AssetMasterData/Asset[AssetType = ('EQ', 'BO', 'SC')][not(Identifiers/ISIN)]
return local:at($a, 'Asset ' || $a/UniqueID || ' (' || $a/Name || ', ' || $a/AssetType || ') has no ISIN')

checks.name: DQ: Options and futures have an underlying
checks.description: Assets of type OP (option) and FU (future) name at least one underlying.
checks.xpath: /FundsXML4/AssetMasterData/Asset[AssetType = ('OP', 'FU')][not(AssetDetails/*/Underlyings/Underlying)]
checks.query:
for $a in /FundsXML4/AssetMasterData/Asset[AssetType = ('OP', 'FU')][not(AssetDetails/*/Underlyings/Underlying)]
return local:at($a, 'Asset ' || $a/UniqueID || ' (' || $a/Name || ', ' || $a/AssetType || ') has no underlying')

checks.name: DQ: Country codes
checks.description: Country elements hold two capital letters (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2); the schema only checks the length.
checks.xpath: //*[local-name() = ('Country', 'SystemCountry', 'BusinessCountry', 'CountryCode', 'CountryOfDomicile', 'DomicileCountry', 'FundCustodianCountry', 'InvestorCountry', 'IssuerCountry', 'ListOfInvestedCountries')][not(*)][normalize-space(.) ne ''][not(matches(normalize-space(.), '^[A-Z]{2}$'))]

checks.name: DQ: BIC format
checks.description: A SwiftBIC has 8 or 11 characters: bank, country, location and an optional branch (ISO 9362); the schema only checks the length.
checks.xpath: //SwiftBIC[not(matches(normalize-space(.), '^[A-Z]{4}[A-Z]{2}[A-Z0-9]{2}([A-Z0-9]{3})?$'))]
checks.query:
for $b in //SwiftBIC[not(matches(normalize-space(.), '^[A-Z]{4}[A-Z]{2}[A-Z0-9]{2}([A-Z0-9]{3})?$'))]
return local:at($b, local:where($b) || ': BIC ' || $b || ' is invalid')

checks.name: DQ: Document generated after its content date
checks.description: DocumentGenerated is neither before the ContentDate nor in the future.
checks.xpath: /FundsXML4/ControlData/DocumentGenerated[. castable as xs:dateTime][let $g := xs:date(substring(., 1, 10)) return $g gt current-date() or (../ContentDate castable as xs:date and $g lt xs:date(../ContentDate))]

checks.name: DQ: No NAV date after the content date
checks.description: No NavDate (portfolio, net asset value, price) is later than the ContentDate.
checks.xpath: //NavDate[. castable as xs:date][/FundsXML4/ControlData/ContentDate castable as xs:date][xs:date(.) gt xs:date(/FundsXML4/ControlData/ContentDate)]

checks.name: DQ: No NAV date before inception
checks.description: No NavDate of a fund, share class, segment or subfund is earlier than its InceptionDate.
checks.xpath: //NavDate[. castable as xs:date][let $o := ancestor::*[self::ShareClass or self::Segment or self::Subfund or self::Fund][1], $i := ($o/InceptionDate, $o/*[ends-with(local-name(), 'StaticData')]/InceptionDate)[. castable as xs:date][1] return exists($i) and xs:date(.) lt xs:date($i)]

checks.name: DQ: Share class dates match the fund
checks.description: Every net asset value date of a share class is also a net asset value date of its fund.
checks.xpath: //Funds/Fund[FundDynamicData/TotalAssetValues/TotalAssetValue]/SingleFund/ShareClasses/ShareClass/TotalAssetValues/TotalAssetValue[not(NavDate = ancestor::Fund[1]/FundDynamicData/TotalAssetValues/TotalAssetValue/NavDate)]
checks.query:
for $f in //Funds/Fund[FundDynamicData/TotalAssetValues/TotalAssetValue]
let $dates := $f/FundDynamicData/TotalAssetValues/TotalAssetValue/NavDate
for $tav in $f/SingleFund/ShareClasses/ShareClass/TotalAssetValues/TotalAssetValue[not(NavDate = $dates)]
return local:at($tav, local:owner($tav) || ': net asset value of ' || $tav/NavDate || ', the fund has none for that date')

checks.name: DQ: Bonds mature after issue
checks.description: A bond's MaturityDate is not before its IssueDate.
checks.xpath: /FundsXML4/AssetMasterData/Asset/AssetDetails/Bond[MaturityDate castable as xs:date and IssueDate castable as xs:date][xs:date(MaturityDate) lt xs:date(IssueDate)]

checks.name: DQ: Earnings settle after entry
checks.description: An earning's ValutaDate is not before its EntryDate.
checks.xpath: //Earning[ValutaDate castable as xs:date and EntryDate castable as xs:date][xs:date(ValutaDate) lt xs:date(EntryDate)]

checks.name: DQ: No transactions after the content date
checks.description: No transaction is entered after the ContentDate.
checks.xpath: //Transaction[EntryDate castable as xs:date][/FundsXML4/ControlData/ContentDate castable as xs:date][xs:date(EntryDate) gt xs:date(/FundsXML4/ControlData/ContentDate)]

checks.name: DQ: Units × price = market value
checks.description: For equities and fund shares, units (shares) × price matches the market value in the same currency (± 1 %).
checks.xpath: //Portfolios/Portfolio/Positions/Position/(Equity | ShareClass)[let $s := ., $u := (($s/Units, $s/Shares)[. castable as xs:decimal])[1] ! xs:decimal(.), $p := ($s/Price/Amount[@ccy = $s/MarketValue/Amount/@ccy][. castable as xs:decimal])[1], $mv := ($s/MarketValue/Amount[@ccy = $p/@ccy][. castable as xs:decimal])[1] ! xs:decimal(.) return exists($u) and exists($p) and exists($mv) and $mv ne 0 and abs($u * xs:decimal($p) - $mv) div abs($mv) gt 0.01]

checks.name: DQ: Nominal × price = bond market value
checks.description: For bonds, nominal × clean price / 100 × pool factor × index factor matches the market value (without interest) in the same currency (± 1 %).
checks.xpath: //Portfolios/Portfolio/Positions/Position/Bond[let $b := ., $n := ($b/Nominal[. castable as xs:decimal])[1] ! xs:decimal(.), $f := (($b/Poolfactor[. castable as xs:decimal])[1] ! xs:decimal(.), 1)[1] * (($b/Indexfactor[. castable as xs:decimal])[1] ! xs:decimal(.), 1)[1], $p := ($b/Price/Amount[@ccy = $b/MarketValue/Amount/@ccy][. castable as xs:decimal])[1], $mv := ($b/MarketValue/Amount[@ccy = $p/@ccy][. castable as xs:decimal])[1] ! xs:decimal(.) return exists($n) and exists($p) and exists($mv) and $mv ne 0 and abs($n * xs:decimal($p) div 100 * $f - $mv) div abs($mv) gt 0.01]
checks.query:
for $pos in //Portfolios/Portfolio/Positions/Position, $b in $pos/Bond
let $nominal := local:dec($b/Nominal)
let $factor := (local:dec($b/Poolfactor), 1)[1] * (local:dec($b/Indexfactor), 1)[1]
let $pairs := for $p in $b/Price/Amount
              let $mv := ($b/MarketValue/Amount[@ccy = $p/@ccy])[1]
              where exists(local:dec($p)) and exists(local:dec($mv)) and local:dec($mv) ne 0
              return map { 'price': local:dec($p), 'value': local:dec($mv), 'ccy': string($p/@ccy) }
let $pair := $pairs[1]
let $calc := $nominal * $pair?price div 100 * $factor
where exists($nominal) and exists($pair) and abs($calc - $pair?value) div abs($pair?value) gt 0.01
return local:at($b, 'Position ' || $pos/UniqueID || ': ' || $nominal || ' × ' || $pair?price || ' % = ' || round($calc, 2) || ' ' || $pair?ccy || ', the market value is ' || $pair?value || ' ' || $pair?ccy)

checks.name: DQ: Position weight matches its value
checks.description: A position's TotalPercentage matches its TotalValue against the net asset value of its owner on that date (± 0.1 percentage points).
checks.xpath: //Portfolios/Portfolio/Positions/Position/TotalPercentage[. castable as xs:decimal][let $pf := ../../.., $ccy := string((ancestor::*[self::ShareClass or self::Segment or self::Subfund or self::Fund][1]/Currency, ancestor::Fund[1]/Currency)[1]), $tna := ($pf/../../TotalAssetValues/TotalAssetValue[NavDate = $pf/NavDate]/TotalNetAssetValue/Amount[@ccy = $ccy][. castable as xs:decimal])[1] ! xs:decimal(.), $v := (../TotalValue/Amount[@ccy = $ccy][. castable as xs:decimal])[1] ! xs:decimal(.) return exists($tna) and $tna ne 0 and exists($v) and abs($v div $tna * 100 - xs:decimal(.)) gt 0.1]

checks.name: DQ: Exchange rates are positive
checks.description: An FXRate is greater than 0, and 1 when it converts a currency into itself.
checks.xpath: //FXRate[. castable as xs:decimal][xs:decimal(.) le 0 or (@fromCcy = @toCcy and xs:decimal(.) ne 1)]
checks.query:
for $r in //FXRate[exists(local:dec(.))][local:dec(.) le 0 or (@fromCcy = @toCcy and local:dec(.) ne 1)]
return local:at($r, local:where($r) || ': FX rate ' || $r/@fromCcy || '→' || $r/@toCcy || ' is ' || $r)

checks.name: DQ: One exchange rate per currency pair
checks.description: The positions of a portfolio use the same rate for the same currency pair.
checks.xpath: //Portfolios/Portfolio/Positions/Position/FXRates/FXRate[. castable as xs:decimal][let $r := . return some $o in ancestor::Portfolio[1]/Positions/Position/FXRates/FXRate[@fromCcy = $r/@fromCcy and @toCcy = $r/@toCcy and @mulDiv = $r/@mulDiv][. castable as xs:decimal] satisfies xs:decimal($o) ne xs:decimal($r)]

checks.name: DQ: Position values agree in sign
checks.description: The TotalValue amounts of a position in different currencies are all positive or all negative.
checks.xpath: //Portfolios/Portfolio/Positions/Position[TotalValue/Amount[. castable as xs:decimal][xs:decimal(.) gt 0] and TotalValue/Amount[. castable as xs:decimal][xs:decimal(.) lt 0]]

checks.name: DQ: Share class ratios add up to 100 %
checks.description: When every share class gives its Ratio for a date, the ratios add up to 100 % (± 0.5).
checks.xpath: //Funds/Fund[SingleFund/ShareClasses/ShareClass/TotalAssetValues/TotalAssetValue/Ratio][let $tavs := SingleFund/ShareClasses/ShareClass/TotalAssetValues/TotalAssetValue return some $d in distinct-values($tavs/NavDate) satisfies (let $day := $tavs[NavDate = $d] return (every $t in $day satisfies $t/Ratio castable as xs:decimal) and abs(sum($day/Ratio ! xs:decimal(.)) - 100) gt 0.5)]

checks.name: DQ: Prices and net asset values are positive
checks.description: NAV prices are greater than 0; shares outstanding and net asset values are not negative.
checks.xpath: //Prices/Price/NavPrice[. castable as xs:decimal][xs:decimal(.) le 0] | //TotalAssetValue/SharesOutstanding[. castable as xs:decimal][xs:decimal(.) lt 0] | //TotalAssetValue/TotalNetAssetValue/Amount[. castable as xs:decimal][xs:decimal(.) lt 0]

checks.name: DQ: One price per date
checks.description: A share class has one price per NavDate, price nature and currency.
checks.xpath: //Prices/Price[let $p := . return exists(preceding-sibling::Price[NavDate = $p/NavDate and string(PriceNature) = string($p/PriceNature) and string(PriceCurrency) = string($p/PriceCurrency)])]

checks.name: DQ: A price in the share class currency
checks.description: For every price date a share class has a price in its own currency.
checks.xpath: //ShareClass[Currency and Prices/Price/PriceCurrency]/Prices/Price[let $p := ., $sc := ../.. return not($sc/Prices/Price[NavDate = $p/NavDate]/PriceCurrency = $sc/Currency)]

checks.name: DQ: Position currency matches the master data
checks.description: A position's Currency is the Currency of its asset in AssetMasterData.
checks.xpath: //Portfolios/Portfolio/Positions/Position[Currency][let $pos := ., $a := (/FundsXML4/AssetMasterData/Asset[UniqueID = $pos/UniqueID][Currency])[1] return exists($a) and string($pos/Currency) ne string($a/Currency)]

checks.name: DQ: FX forwards are consistent
checks.description: An FX forward buys and sells different currencies, both amounts are positive, and the agreed rate matches AmountBuy / AmountSell or its inverse (± 1 %).
checks.xpath: /FundsXML4/AssetMasterData/Asset/AssetDetails/FXForward[let $b := (AmountBuy[. castable as xs:decimal])[1] ! xs:decimal(.), $s := (AmountSell[. castable as xs:decimal])[1] ! xs:decimal(.), $r := (AgreedFxRate[. castable as xs:decimal])[1] ! xs:decimal(.) return (exists(CurrencyBuy) and string(CurrencyBuy) eq string(CurrencySell)) or $b le 0 or $s le 0 or (exists($b) and exists($s) and exists($r) and $b gt 0 and $s gt 0 and $r gt 0 and abs($b div $s - $r) div $r gt 0.01 and abs($s div $b - $r) div $r gt 0.01)]

checks.name: DQ: Bond prices are plausible
checks.description: A bond position's clean price (in percent of nominal) is greater than 0 and at most 250.
checks.xpath: //Portfolios/Portfolio/Positions/Position/Bond/Price/Amount[. castable as xs:decimal][xs:decimal(.) le 0 or xs:decimal(.) gt 250]
checks.query:
for $p in //Portfolios/Portfolio/Positions/Position/Bond/Price/Amount[exists(local:dec(.))][local:dec(.) le 0 or local:dec(.) gt 250]
return local:at($p, 'Position ' || $p/ancestor::Position[1]/UniqueID || ': bond price ' || $p || ' ' || $p/@ccy || ' is not plausible')

checks.name: DQ: Funds have a LEI, share classes an ISIN
checks.description: Hint: funds carry a LEI and share classes an ISIN, as most receivers expect.
checks.xpath: //Funds/Fund[not(Identifiers/LEI)] | //ShareClasses/ShareClass[not(Identifiers/ISIN)]

checks.name: DQ: OTC derivatives name their counterparty's LEI
checks.description: Hint: FX forwards (FX) and swaps (SW) name the counterparty's LEI (EMIR reporting).
checks.xpath: /FundsXML4/AssetMasterData/Asset[AssetType = ('FX', 'SW')][not(AssetDetails/*/Counterparty/Identifiers/LEI)]
checks.query:
for $a in /FundsXML4/AssetMasterData/Asset[AssetType = ('FX', 'SW')][not(AssetDetails/*/Counterparty/Identifiers/LEI)]
return local:at($a, 'Asset ' || $a/UniqueID || ' (' || $a/Name || ', ' || $a/AssetType || ') has no counterparty LEI')

checks.name: DQ: Accounts name their bank
checks.description: Hint: accounts (AC) name the bank with a LEI or BIC.
checks.xpath: /FundsXML4/AssetMasterData/Asset[AssetType = 'AC'][not(AssetDetails/Account/Counterparty/Identifiers/(LEI | SwiftBIC))]
checks.query:
for $a in /FundsXML4/AssetMasterData/Asset[AssetType = 'AC'][not(AssetDetails/Account/Counterparty/Identifiers/(LEI | SwiftBIC))]
return local:at($a, 'Account ' || $a/UniqueID || ' (' || $a/Name || ') has no counterparty LEI or BIC')

checks.name: DQ: Derivative positions have exposures
checks.description: Hint: positions in futures, options, swaps and FX forwards give their exposure (Exposures).
checks.xpath: //Portfolios/Portfolio/Positions/Position[Future or Option or Swap or FXForward][not(Exposures/Exposure)]
checks.query:
for $pos in //Portfolios/Portfolio/Positions/Position[Future or Option or Swap or FXForward][not(Exposures/Exposure)]
return local:at($pos, 'Position ' || $pos/UniqueID || ' (' || local-name($pos/(Future | Option | Swap | FXForward)[1]) || ') has no exposure')

checks.name: DQ: Positions with a value
checks.description: Hint: positions whose every TotalValue amount is 0 (closed positions that are still reported).
checks.xpath: //Portfolios/Portfolio/Positions/Position[TotalValue/Amount][every $a in TotalValue/Amount satisfies ($a castable as xs:decimal and xs:decimal($a) = 0)]

checks.name: DQ: Recent portfolios
checks.description: Hint: the latest portfolio of a fund, share class, segment or subfund is more than 31 days older than the ContentDate.
checks.xpath: //Portfolios[/FundsXML4/ControlData/ContentDate castable as xs:date][Portfolio/NavDate[. castable as xs:date]][xs:date(/FundsXML4/ControlData/ContentDate) - max(Portfolio/NavDate[. castable as xs:date] ! xs:date(.)) gt xs:dayTimeDuration('P31D')]

snippets.name: FundsXML: All funds
snippets.description: Name, LEI and currency of every fund.

snippets.name: FundsXML: Top 10 positions
snippets.description: The ten largest positions by market value, with name and weight (fund portfolios; share-class portfolios repeat them).
snippets.query:
let $assets := /FundsXML4/AssetMasterData/Asset
let $top := (for $p in (//FundDynamicData | //SubfundDynamicData)/Portfolios/Portfolio/Positions/Position
             order by xs:decimal(($p/TotalValue/Amount)[1]) descending
             return $p)[position() le 10]
for $p in $top
return string-join(($p/UniqueID, ($assets[UniqueID = $p/UniqueID]/Name, '')[1], $p/TotalValue/Amount[1] || ' ' || $p/TotalValue/Amount[1]/@ccy, $p/TotalPercentage || ' %'), ' | ')

snippets.name: FundsXML: Exposure by asset type
snippets.description: Sum of market values and weights per AssetType (joined with AssetMasterData) (fund portfolios; share-class portfolios repeat them).
snippets.query:
let $assets := /FundsXML4/AssetMasterData/Asset
for $type in distinct-values($assets/AssetType)
let $ids := $assets[AssetType = $type]/UniqueID
let $pos := (//FundDynamicData | //SubfundDynamicData)/Portfolios/Portfolio/Positions/Position[UniqueID = $ids]
order by sum($pos/TotalPercentage ! xs:decimal(.)) descending
return $type || ': ' || count($pos) || ' positions, ' || sum($pos/TotalPercentage ! xs:decimal(.)) || ' %'

snippets.name: FundsXML: Exposure by currency
snippets.description: Sum of position weights per position currency (fund portfolios; share-class portfolios repeat them).
snippets.query:
let $all := (//FundDynamicData | //SubfundDynamicData)/Portfolios/Portfolio/Positions/Position
for $c in distinct-values($all/Currency)
let $pos := $all[Currency = $c]
order by sum($pos/TotalPercentage ! xs:decimal(.)) descending
return $c || ': ' || sum($pos/TotalPercentage ! xs:decimal(.)) || ' % in ' || count($pos) || ' positions'

snippets.name: FundsXML: UCITS 5/10/40 concentration
snippets.description: Weight per issuer (LEI or name from AssetMasterData, else the position) of the securities of every fund portfolio: issuers over 10 %, and the sum of all issuers over 5 % (UCITS limit 40 %). Only meaningful for UCITS funds; government bonds, which UCITS treats separately, count like any issuer.
